# A block of dark rock (3, at 176,96) stands on a column of ice (i, x 176-223, y 112-191) that reaches the floor

# (291): it breaks (301) into its big piece (oRubbleDark, at 189,112) and two small ones (oRubbleDarkSmall). The
# small ones stop at the ice, as oRubblePiece's step destroys them on any solid: one is in it already (302), the
# other lands on it (305). The big piece's own step stops only on a brick or a stone block (oBrick, oBlock), so
# it falls down through the five blocks of ice, drawn in front of them, and is destroyed on the floor's bricks
# (318). Nothing breaks the ice, and the dark rock has no gold in it.
